theorems.name: Submission.idtp_fons_odc_ray_orientation
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1) (F : Finset (Euclid P)), (∀ e ∈ F, ‖e‖ = 1) → (μHE[1] : Measure (Euclid P)) (R.carrier ∩ (⋃ e ∈ F, (fun t : ℝ => t • e) '' Ioi 0)ᶜ) = 0 → ∀ e ∈ F, ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[1] : Measure (Euclid P)).restrict (R.carrier ∩ (fun t : ℝ => t • e) '' Ioi 0)), R.orient x = ContinuousAlternatingMap.apply ℝ (Euclid P) ℝ (fun _ : Fin 1 => e) ∨ R.orient x = -ContinuousAlternatingMap.apply ℝ (Euclid P) ℝ (fun _ : Fin 1 => e)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
